Neeko|mid.identity: Magic damage mage who deceives her opponents. Her passive Inherent Glamour lets her take the appearance of an ally or other units on the map; the disguise breaks if she's hit by rooting CC, casts a damaging ability or takes too much damage. Blooming Burst (Q) explodes and blooms again if it hits a champion, Shapesplitter (W) empowers her attacks and creates a clone while making her invisible, Tangle-Barbs (E) roots, and Pop Blossom (R) makes her leap before an explosion that stuns in an area.
Neeko|mid.playstyle: In mid, Neeko is a burst and engage mage: poke with Q, CC with E and a big area engage with R, often disguised to catch enemies by surprise.
Neeko|mid.early_game: Poke with Q (it blooms again if it hits a champion) and E when your opponent comes to last hit. Use your disguise to fool ganks or get close. Keep W to escape with your clone.
Neeko|mid.level_1: Blooming Burst (Q) first. Poke and farm.
Neeko|mid.level_2: Tangle-Barbs (E). CC (longer if it passes through an enemy before the target): E → Q.
Neeko|mid.level_3: Shapesplitter (W). Empowered attacks and a clone: W lets you escape by turning invisible while the clone runs.
Neeko|mid.level_6: Pop Blossom: a leap, then an explosion that stuns in an area. Combo: approach disguised → R → E → Q. In teamfights, aim for several grouped enemies.
power_spikes: Mid game: surprise engages in disguise.
Neeko|mid.lane_plan: Poke and farm, push the wave, then roam in disguise. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you chain roams. Avoid assassins who dive you (Ekko).
Neeko|mid.trading: Short trade: E → Q. All-in: R → E → Q → attacks. Defense: W for the clone and invisibility. Give up on it against champions who burst you before your engage.
threats: Ekko and assassins who dive you.
Veigar, who traps you in his cage.
A small sample: matchup trends are less reliable.
mistakes: Breaking your disguise by casting a damaging ability too early.
Casting R when you can't hit several targets in teamfights.
Using W to attack and having no escape left.

matchup_notes.Ahri: Keep E for the end of her ultimate.
matchup_notes.Viktor: Poke him and engage when his Gravity Field is on cooldown.
matchup_notes.Syndra: Engage when her stun is on cooldown.
matchup_notes.Lissandra: Her control is less effective against your disguise.
matchup_notes.Ekko: He dives you: keep W to escape.

Neeko|mid.mid_game: Surprise engages in disguise, picks and objectives.
Neeko|mid.late_game: Approach disguised and R on several enemies, then E and Q. Stay behind your frontline if your ultimate is on cooldown.
Neeko|mid.behind: Farm and play for a decisive engage with R.
Neeko|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to surprise the enemy team with disguised engages and an area stun.
Neeko|mid.final_tip: Approach in disguise: the enemy won't react until your ultimate is already cast.
